description: Ternary Bonsai2 9B is Prism ML’s open-weight model derived from Qwen3.5-9B with ternary language weights. It accepts text and generates text, supports reasoning and tool calling, and offers a shared 262,144-token context window with up to 65,536 output tokens. Thinking is enabled by default and can be turned off.
name: Ternary Bonsai2 9B
